The '''Internal Safeguards Division (ISD)''',<ref name="Star_Wars_Sourcebook" /> also known as the '''Imperial Safeguards Division''', was a branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] charged with ensuring that [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was safe for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to travel. It was rumored to use [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] to keep the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] "clean"<ref name="CSWE" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Chronology note" /> despite an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] edict banning them with the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]<ref name="Star_Wars_Sourcebook" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Some sources claimed that one-third of all secret high-level ISD arrests and [[Death/Legends|eliminations]] were completed by the Division's [[Droid/Legends|droids]], though an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] was almost always on site. It was not known whether the Internal Safeguards Division's use of [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] droids was officially sanctioned, or if they were used illicitly by bureaus reluctant to give them up.<ref name="Star_Wars_Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Internal Safeguards Division was first mentioned in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', a [[1987]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sourcebook written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
